item.title: Tinubu: No Agent of Instability Will Undermine Nigeria’s Peace, Unity
item.description: President Tinubu assures Nigerians the country will defeat terrorism and protect its unity and sovereignty amid rising security challenges.

item.title: ‘Landmark Judgment’: Okey Osuoha Lauds Court Of Appeal’s Judgment On PDP’s Convention
item.description: Okey Osuoha hails the Court of Appeal's ruling on PDP's convention, calls it a landmark judgment.

item.title: Ignore Calls To Cancel Tantita Contract, Eradiri Urges Tinubu
item.description: Former IYC president Udengs Eradiri urges Tinubu to retain Tantita contract, saying it has restored peace in Niger Delta.

item.title: Wumi Iledare: Current Petrol Price Hikes Not Driven By lack Of Supply Yet
item.description: Professor Emeritus of Petroleum Economics, Wumi Iledare, says petrol hikes aren’t due to supply shortages, praises Nigerians’ calm adaptation.

item.title: Governor Sule Supervises Distribution Of Dangote Foundation Rice To Nasarawa LGs
item.description: Governor Sule supervises distribution of Dangote Foundation rice across Nasarawa’s 13 LGs, warns officials against diversion of palliatives.

item.title: Adeboro Adamson: ICPC Can Extend Detention In Court Without Explaining To The Public, El-Rufai’s Detention Is Legal
item.description: Senior Advocate Adeboro Adamson says ICPC legally detained ex-Kaduna governor El-Rufai under ACJA provisions allowing court-approved remand.

item.title: IGP Disu Vows To Reclaim Communities Overrun By Bandits
item.description: IGP Olatunji Disu pledges to reclaim communities seized by bandits in Kwara and across Nigeria.

item.title: Rivers Assembly Confirms Five Commissioner Nominees, Rejects Four
item.description: Rivers Assembly confirms five commissioner nominees and rejects four after screening during plenary session in Port Harcourt.

item.title: NSCDC Threatens Contractors With Prosecution Over Damage to Abuja Fibre Optic Cables
item.description: NSCDC warns contractors damaging fibre-optic cables in Abuja will face arrest and prosecution over threats to national infrastructure.

item.title: Taiwo Oyedele Meets Tinubu After Nomination As Deputy Finance Minister
item.description: President Tinubu meets Minister of State for Finance nominee Taiwo Oyedele to discuss fiscal reforms and revenue strategy.
